title: Encrypted DNS Session Attempt Planning Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, focused adapter tests, DNS package build, SpecTrace validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for deterministic encrypted DNS session-attempt planning.
scope: This verification covers creating scalar encrypted DNS session attempts from RFC 9461 service-binding endpoint selection, RFC 9463 discovery client plans, and RFC 9464 provisioning client plans, rejecting Do53-port encrypted attempts, suppressing attempts for Do53-preferred discovery or NULL-authentication-blocked provisioning inputs, and fake-backed ordered connector invocation.
preconditions: The caller supplies already-validated SVCB, discovery, or provisioning client plans.
Discovery and provisioning callers supply the protocol and port when they need values other than the DoQ default.
expected_result: The focused planner tests pass, the DNS package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9463 artifacts, generated triage remains trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: Encrypted DNS session establishment is locally narrowed to deterministic attempt planning. Live encrypted DNS transport, IKEv2/IPsec integration, host resolver installation, and provider/platform integration remain external adapter work.
